acceptanceCriteria: A recorded decision: keep `finished` as the carrier (and update the #1148 wording) or add a per-worker stopped event with the fields
If changed, ATR-V0-127 is amended and a test asserts the fields on the chosen event
body: Residual from V1-1834 (PR #1153, ATR-V0-125..127). The #1148 acceptance asked that `launched`/`stopped` events record whether warnings and salvage ran. The dispatcher's `stopped` event is program-level and names no worker, so the lane put the fields on the worker-stop event `finished` and recorded the mapping in ATR-V0-127. Evidence: TestATRV0125_NoticeFileDeliversOnAnyHost. Decide whether the mapping is acceptable or a per-worker stopped event is wanted.
title: Question: should warning/salvage fields live on the worker `finished` event, or should dispatch gain a per-worker `stopped` event (GitHub #1148 AC)
